summary: Updates move only to approved versions, group policies get the safety brake, and on-premises AD admins work as in v1.

new.title: On-premises AD admins work as in v1
new.text: On-premises AD admins are created and kept up to date in Active Directory, named by your naming settings. Their initial password is mailed and never stored.

new.title: Choose which managed tenants get each admin
new.text: On a managing tenant, each admin says whether it is synced to managed tenants, optionally narrowed to tagged tenants. The Manager shows the tenant's mode.

new.title: See what naming patterns produce
new.text: Settings shows the result of each naming pattern as you edit it.

fixes.title: Updates follow the approved release
fixes.text: Each environment moves only to the version its ring approves, and the nightly update refuses to roll when it cannot check the database first.

fixes.title: Every cloud admin gets a Temporary Access Pass
fixes.text: A Temporary Access Pass is issued to every cloud admin. On-premises AD admins use a password.

fixes.title: Remove rows revoke the access
fixes.text: Marking a delegation for removal revokes it, eligible and active, before removing the row. A held or failed removal keeps its row.

fixes.title: Safety brake for group and role policies
fixes.text: Group and Entra role policy changes now have the same safety brake as Azure policies.

fixes.title: Smaller improvements
fixes.text: Faster runs, clearer permission errors, mail sent as the environment's own identity, everything kept in the database, and templates gaining new settings without losing yours.
